name: 2 Ship 2 Harkinian
game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
summary: Official 2 Ship 2 Harkinian runtimes with mm.o2r generated from your Majora's Mask ROM, in a portable folder.

first_run.summary: mm.o2r is generated from your Majora's Mask ROM during the build, so 2Ship starts without asking for the ROM.

release_rules.notes: Stable numbered releases only. Each release ships Linux and Win64 ZIPs named 2Ship-<Codename>-<Platform>.zip.

linux.description: Official Linux AppImage. Also used to generate mm.o2r for every platform.

inputs.label: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (USA) N64 ROM
inputs.notes: SHA-1 is checked after byte-order normalization. Upstream also lists NTSC-U GC; it has not been packaged here.

source_checks.description: Upstream still lists your ROM revision as supported

operations.text:
2 Ship 2 Harkinian {version} portable package.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder, then run {launch_command}.
mm.o2r was generated from your verified Majora's Mask ROM. SHIP_HOME keeps settings and saves in this folder; keep the whole folder together when moving it.
Official upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Packaging checks file structure only. Record startup or gameplay results separately for this exact download.

linux.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.sh. It sets SHIP_HOME to the package folder and runs the AppImage without FUSE.

windows.instructions: Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd. It sets SHIP_HOME to the package folder.

saves: SHIP_HOME points at the package folder, so 2ship2harkinian.json settings, saves and logs stay beside the game. Carry them forward when replacing the folder.

linux: x86-64 Linux desktop with working graphics drivers
No FUSE needed; the launcher sets APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1

limitations: mm.o2r is generated by the Linux AppImage under a virtual display. Its archive is not byte-for-byte reproducible: a few limb resources differ between runs, so packages are compared by checksum per build, not across builds.
The Windows package reuses the mm.o2r generated by the Linux AppImage of the same release.
Windows packages have not been launched on native Windows.

verified_releases.evidence: Manual 2026-10-11 package: Linux startup checked on Fedora; Windows assembled, not launched (RomM 12963 / 12966).

history: 2026-10-11: first packages assembled with outputs/package-native-ports.py after running the AppImage with the ROM on a desktop to create mm.o2r. This definition automates the same steps.
